component.name: atlifm
component.summary: Terminal-style file manager with GUI features

description.p: atlifm is a mouse-first file manager that keeps a terminal aesthetic: a multi-pane layout, monospace font and no animations, while adding drag and drop, tabs, previews and XDG desktop portal integration.

ul.li: Miller columns with parent / current / preview panes
Mouse interaction, drag and drop, tabs and independent histories
Image, SVG, code, directory tree and hex previews
Interactive browsing and extraction of zip, tar, 7z and rar archives
Full undo / redo for file operations
Plugins: config, shell script and native C++ plugins

screenshot.caption: Miller columns, tabs and preview pane

description.p: default file manager integration, filemanager1 dbus service, live plugin previews and archive password support.
Multiple windows, layout restore, search scope and memory fixes.
